A hexagonal core with a luminous orb inside a fine ring sits at the centre, surrounded by six isometric stacked planes at different depths, each a discrete workspace slab, connected by hairline paths. A dotted grid recedes into the dark ground. Exact title 'Octo' set large and bold in a clean geometric sans, with exact subtitle 'Your project's data layer.' smaller and lighter beneath it, both warm off-white and left-aligned in the left third. No other text, no logos, no UI panels, no fake metrics, no humanoid robots, no floating padlocks, no lens flares.
